selections.raw: He hath created the Primal Will - the Essential, the Exemplary, the Simple, the Ethereal, the Abstract, the Beloved, the Eternal, the Resplendent, the Divine Fruit, the Eternal Countenance, the Everlasting Face of Grandeur - not from anything, through itself, by itself. He revealed Himself unto it through it, by its own essence, and through it He withheld Himself from all else. … He cast into its reality the image of its revelation  BB00005
